defect_found: Gradient tracing showed the V3-001/002/003 trainers never applied the reader's static supervision to route-2 items (they only trained the uncertainty branch on those frames), so the route head only ever saw r0/r1 labels - explaining the bit-identical degenerate routing across all three runs. DG-019/026 applied static loss to ALL records; the V3 trainers diverged from that protocol by mistake, not by design.
fix: Plain FineSpanReader (no structural scalars, no detach, no weighting - reverting V3-002/003 changes), unweighted losses, and route-2 items additionally receive the reader static fine_loss at their prefix-0 frame alongside the branch CE. Verified by gradient trace: route p2 logit rises under the corrected loss.
evaluation: EV-004: identical panel/protocol/gates with fresh dual review for any new packets
decision: this run isolates the supervision-defect factor with everything else identical to V3-001
